text:
mira: quick FYI — I'm starting a small probe that combines FlashAttention v2 + paged-attn + fused opchain on our staging kernels. Need a few quick benches and regression checks. TL;DR: run the bench job on nv-perf-4 (and nv-perf-6 if available), capture nvprof/ptrace, p99 tail latencies, and mem alloc snapshots. cc @sam @priya :eyes:

sam: got it. I'll kick off nv-perf-4 and nv-perf-6. Do you want me to run the longprompt suite as well or stick to the short/med sequences?

mira: start with short/med (seq 512/1024) + one long (4096) to catch KV cliff regressions. If any anomalous mem growth, also run the 16k synthetic.

priya: on the canary question — do we want a canary policy after smoke? or just a quick bisect if we see regressions?

mira: smoke -> canary (10% traffic on dedicated pool) if smoke is green. If smoke fails, we bisect locally first. PR for the kernel change is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4212

leo: does this touch the KV layout? want to know if we need to re-run the kv-alignment tests.

mira: yes it tweaks KV stride alignment for paged paths. Please run the kv_tail_regression test and the longprompt_kv_cliff canary (those are in perf/tests/kv_*).

sam: plan: 
1) run bench command below on nv-perf-4 and -6
2) collect nvprof + nvtx traces
3) upload to https://perf.redwood.ai/dashboard?id=kernel-experiments and paste link here

```bash
# bench command (example)
./tools/run_bench \
  --model=gpt-3-small \
  --kernel=flashpaged-fuse \
  --seq_len=4096 \
  --batch=1 \
  --quant=none \
  --iters=200 \
  --nvprof=on
```

mira: baseline numbers for comparison (from master): p50=10ms, p95=45ms, p99=110ms, Vram steady ~7.2GB for seq=4096 batch=1. If p99 jumps >20% or vram increases >300MB, flag it.

priya: noted. I'll also add an eval run against the regression promptset (perf/evals/promptsets/paged_attn_regress.json) — run as follow-up after smoke.

sam: buildbot queued the job: buildbot:job/2182001299 queued on nv-perf-4 :robot_face:

buildbot: job 2182001301 started (nv-perf-4)

sam: first smoke (seq 512, batch=4) looks fine. p99 ~18ms, mem stable. Starting seq=4096 run now.

buildbot: job 2182001312 finished (nv-perf-4) — artifacts uploaded to s3://perf-artifacts/2182001312/ (nvprof, pstat, logs)

sam: uploaded perf link: https://perf.redwood.ai/artifacts/2182001312 — NVTX shows a short stall at attention kernel boundary, looks like an extra memcpy around kv-merge.

leo: can you paste the nvprof stack snippet? even a small trace helps.

sam: snippet:
```
[  10.2ms] fused_flash_attention_kernel
[  10.6ms] kv_merge_memcpy
[  10.7ms] paged_attention_dispatch
```

priya: hunch: the memcpy might be from a fallback path when page map isn't hot. Is cache-hit heuristic tuned?

mira: good call. The PR added a conservative hot-check; maybe too conservative. Sam, can you re-run with HOT_CACHE=1 env to force hot path? Command: `HOT_CACHE=1 ./tools/run_bench ...`

sam: re-run queued with HOT_CACHE=1, will report.

buildbot: job 2182001380 started (nv-perf-6)

sam: re-run results: p99 down to 98ms (was 125ms), memcpy gone from nvprof. HOT_CACHE flagged the hot path so it avoids memcpy.

mira: ok that's helpful — indicates heuristic is the culprit, not the core kernel. Priya, can you try a smaller threshold in the heuristic in the PR? maybe reduce required contiguous pages from 4 -> 2.

priya: will make a patch and run quick bench. ping me if you want me to push to the same PR or open a follow-up.

leo: when we do canary, let's include a fallback policy that routes to flash-only kernel for requests with seq>8k, in case paged path misbehaves under tail load.

mira: agreed. Next steps:
- priya: adjust heuristic + bench (today)
- sam: run full longprompt suite and upload artifacts (by 2pm PST)
- leo: prepare canary rollout config snippet (10% on dedicated pool) and fallback route
- mira: I'll prepare a short runbook for oncall in case we see memory spikes

sam: noted. I'll post links once all artifacts are up.

priya: patch pushed to PR 4212 as commit f2e9a3c, running bench now.

buildbot: job 2182001975 finished (nv-perf-6) — all artifacts at https://perf.redwood.ai/artifacts/2182001975/ :white_check_mark:

mira: thanks everyone. If results stay green we'll do a canary tomorrow morning. If any regression appears, we'll bisect and revert. :thumbsup:
